title: Music Genre Classification Engine
summary: Spark-native distributed machine learning pipeline for music genre classification using an ensemble approach combining Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Trees, and Logistic Regression across distributed clusters.
problem: Music genre classification at scale requires processing large audio datasets with complex spectral features. Single-machine solutions don't scale, and naive distributed approaches lose ML accuracy.
solution: Built a fully Spark-native pipeline: distributed audio feature extraction, distributed ensemble model training, and parallelized hyperparameter tuning — all without leaving the Spark ecosystem.
achievements: Fully Spark-native pipeline from feature extraction to model serving
Ensemble combining Random Forest, GBT, and Logistic Regression with diversity regularization
Scalable distributed feature extraction across audio datasets
MLflow tracking for experiment management and model versioning

architecture.title: Distributed Pipeline Architecture
architecture.content: Stage 1: Distributed audio loading and resampling using Spark RDDs. Stage 2: Parallel feature extraction (MFCCs, spectral centroids, chroma features, zero-crossing rate) via PySpark UDFs. Stage 3: Distributed model training with cross-validation. Stage 4: Ensemble aggregation with soft voting. Stage 5: MLflow model registration.
